row: Advanced S.P.O.R.T.S. is an outpatient orthopedic physical therapy clinic born in 2004. Frank McCoy is the owner and operator, as well as a certified physical therapist that is passionate about injury prevention. We offer the most up to date, evidence based treatment available, and specialize in sports/general orthopedic physical therapy to all age groups. We provide a positive and motivating atmosphere for all!
